summary: First 40k-episode MAGELLAN run (seed=0, buffer=250k, 64 envs). Grasp reached 100% at step 4002 (consistent with 706d17e9). grow_plants first crossed 100% at step 24013 but showed 3 collapses back below 50%, with fraction_above_last_quarter=0.6 — not yet stably solved despite the final value reading 1.0. grow_herbivores and grow_carnivores remain at 0%. Alpha collapsed to 0.0016 but entropy climbed to 1.35. No diag metrics present.

findings.description: Reached 100% at step 4002. Stable: n_collapses=0, fraction_above_last_quarter=1.0.

First crossed 100% at step 24013 but showed 3 collapses below 50% (min_after_first_crossing=0.047 — near catastrophic forgetting). fraction_above_last_quarter=0.6 means still oscillating in the final 10k episodes. The final_metrics value of 1.0 is misleading — it reflects the last measurement point, not stable mastery.
findings.recommendation: Run 80-100k episodes to see if grow_plants stabilizes. Consider whether alpha collapse (0.0016) is reducing the exploration needed to stay consistent on grow_plants.

findings.description: Both 0%. grow_plants itself only intermittently solved — herbivore/carnivore chain goals require grow_plants as a prerequisite, so 0% is expected.
findings.recommendation: Need grow_plants to be stably solved first, then extend run length.

findings.description: Alpha decayed to 0.0016 early but entropy climbed to 1.35. Near-zero temperature means the policy is not being pushed to explore by SAC's entropy bonus — the grow_plants oscillation may be related.
findings.recommendation: Try setting a minimum alpha floor (e.g. 0.01) to maintain some exploration pressure on the harder goals.

findings.description: Finite, no NaN. Rose from 0.091 to 1.35 despite near-zero alpha — policy naturally diversified as it tackled grow_plants.

LP estimates are non-zero for all goal types including herbivores (0.038) and carnivores (0.040), but those goals were never solved. No diag/sr_impossibles or raw_lp metrics to verify SR head quality.
findings.recommendation: Enable diag metrics in next run. Check if LP for herbivores rose after grow_plants succeeded (around step 24k+).

comparison: vs. 706d17e9 (10k, buffer=100k): grow_plants jumped from 9.4% to nominally 100% but with significant volatility (3 collapses). Grasp speed unchanged (~4002). Buffer increased 100k→250k. Key finding: grow_plants is learnable at 40k but not yet stable — more episodes or higher alpha floor needed.
